items.claim: CEO 宣布 2026 全年目標第二次上調（營收與調整後 EBITA margin）
items.quote: we are upgrading for the second time in 2026
items.speaker: Olivier Blum

items.claim: 全年有機營收成長目標 12%–14%
items.quote: between 12% and 14% organically
items.speaker: Olivier Blum

items.claim: 全年調整後 EBITA margin 隱含約 19.7%–19.9%（有機 +100 至 +120bps）
items.quote: adjusted EBITA margin of around 19.7% to 19.9%
items.speaker: Olivier Blum

items.claim: 匯率對全年 margin 影響預期可忽略
items.quote: negligible impact in adjusted EBITA margin for the full year
items.speaker: Nathan Fast

items.claim: 管理層預期 2026 年以價格行動以價值計抵銷原物料與關稅逆風
items.quote: expect to offset in value for 2026 the headwinds
items.speaker: Nathan Fast

items.claim: Q3 產品價格貢獻金額與整個上半年相當
items.quote: product pricing in Q3 around the same level in value
items.speaker: Nathan Fast

items.claim: 全年區間上調同時收窄，說明為信心與能見度提高
items.quote: we have also narrowed the range
items.speaker: Nathan Fast

items.claim: CFO 回應 Q4 隱含放緩：基期為 2025 年最強季度之一
items.quote: the baseline was the strongest quarter in 2025
items.speaker: Nathan Fast

items.claim: 資料中心需求再一季三位數成長
items.quote: another quarter of triple digit demand growth in Q3
items.speaker: Nathan Fast

items.claim: 預製化（prefab）占比不揭露，僅稱成長極強
items.quote: we don't give the exact split of the prefab business
items.speaker: Nathan Fast

items.claim: AVEVA ARR 與 Q3 有機成長均約 10%
items.quote: AVEVA's ARR and Q3 organic sales growth both at around 10%
items.speaker: Nathan Fast

items.claim: Q4 預期趨勢中，成長國家新增中國（原為美國、印度）
items.quote: we add China alongside U.S. and India
items.speaker: Nathan Fast

items.claim: CEO 稱與客戶討論後，中國成長水準至少可延續至 2027
items.quote: this level of growth could continue at least across '27
items.speaker: Olivier Blum

items.claim: 年初對中國需求是否短期現象較為保守（敘事與當時不同）
items.quote: we were a bit more cautious in our answer
items.speaker: Olivier Blum

items.claim: CEO 說明客戶選擇上高度挑剔（技術共同設計、財務能力）
items.quote: we are extremely careful to select those company
items.speaker: Olivier Blum

items.claim: 去年底資料中心與網路占營收 30%，今年預期集中度上升
items.quote: was 30% on data center and networks
items.speaker: Nathan Fast

items.claim: 中國通路優勢：最大夥伴網絡
items.quote: we are the largest network of partner in the country
items.speaker: Olivier Blum

items.claim: 800V 等技術轉向目前客戶端尚未提出疑問
items.quote: we have not had a question on 800 volt
items.speaker: Nathan Fast

items.claim: 持續於區域據點擴充產能（含液冷，與 Foxconn 合作）
items.quote: capacity investments across our regional hubs
items.speaker: Nathan Fast

items.claim: 住宅端貢獻不及其他板塊
items.quote: residential has not matched the level of the other segments
items.speaker: Nathan Fast

items.claim: 工業自動化 Process 與 Hybrid 成長仍疲弱
items.quote: Sales growth in Process and Hybrid remains subdued overall
items.speaker: Nathan Fast

items.claim: CFO 指出下一波投入成本（半導體、記憶體、銅）上漲
items.quote: Now we see the next wave coming
items.speaker: Nathan Fast

items.claim: 建築市場：高利率目前未見對需求的影響
items.quote: We have not seen any impact from higher interest rates.
items.speaker: Nathan Fast

items.claim: 若 2027 有通膨壓力，將再執行定價
items.quote: we'll be flexing those muscles from an execution perspective
items.speaker: Nathan Fast

qa_flags.question: Ben Heelan (BofA)：2027 是否還會有漲價以抵銷成本？
qa_flags.response_pattern: 明說不給 2027 指引，改談年內三輪漲價與定價紀律，未回答 2027 漲價幅度

qa_flags.question: Max Yates (Morgan Stanley)：資料中心訂單在超大型雲端、neocloud、其他的拆分
qa_flags.response_pattern: 兩度表明不揭露分類拆分，僅稱曝險「應與大盤相當」並稱選擇性高

qa_flags.question: Delphine Brault (Oddo)：新指引隱含 Q4 放緩，原因為何？
qa_flags.response_pattern: 提及多重情境與高基期，未給 Q4 具體數字或確認是否保守
